create_Wav2Vec2SslEvalRecipeConfig: create a Wav2Vec2SslEvalRecipeConfig dataclass instance to configure wav2vec2 SSL evaluation
configure_model_section: configure the ReferenceModelSection to load a wav2vec2_base checkpoint for evaluation
configure_dataset_section: configure the Wav2Vec2SslDatasetSection with valid_split for SSL evaluation data
configure_evaluator_section: configure the EvaluatorSection with amp and amp_dtype for mixed precision evaluation
configure_loss_section: configure the Wav2Vec2SslLossSection to set loss criteria for SSL evaluation
